name: jev
description: Starts jev-lsp --stdio and wires its diagnostics, code actions, code lenses, hover and commands into Cursor.

commands.title: Jev: status — queue, budgets, endpoints in force
Jev: inspect this file — run the rules pass now
Jev: review this file — the chat tier, now
Jev: explain the scope at the cursor
Jev: ask a question about this file
Jev: ask a follow-up about the scope at the cursor
Jev: plan a goal at the cursor
Jev: usage — what was offered and what was done with it
Jev: revert an applied edit by id

jev.server.path.markdownDescription: The server binary. An absolute path is safer than a name: a macOS GUI application does not inherit the login shell's `PATH`.

jev.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments for the server. `--stdio` is what this extension speaks.

jev.decide.baseUrl.markdownDescription: The decide tier's base URL; sets `JEV_DECIDE_BASE_URL`. Empty leaves the environment's value alone.

jev.decide.wire.markdownDescription: The decide wire; sets `JEV_DECIDE_WIRE`. `system_one` posts to `/systemone`, `open_router` to `/alpha/decisions` (PROTOCOL §10).

jev.decide.apiKeyEnv.markdownDescription: The **name** of the variable holding the decide key; sets `JEV_DECIDE_API_KEY_ENV`. Never the key itself. Empty keeps the server's default, `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`.

jev.decide.apiKeyFile.markdownDescription: A file to read the decide key's value from, so it need not be pasted into a setting. Either the file is the key, or it is a shell file and the key is the value of the last `NAME=value` for the name in `jev.decide.apiKeyEnv`. `~/.bash_profile` and `~/.zshrc` work. The value is passed to the server's environment and never logged.

jev.decide.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: The decide tier's timeout in milliseconds; sets `JEV_DECIDE_TIMEOUT_MS`. `0` leaves the server's default.

jev.chat.baseUrl.markdownDescription: The chat tiers' base URL, for actions, plans and explanations; sets `JEV_BASE_URL`. Unset means those commands answer `model_error`, and diagnostics still work.

jev.chat.apiKeyEnv.markdownDescription: The **name** of the variable holding the chat key; sets `JEV_API_KEY_ENV`. Never the key itself.

jev.chat.apiKeyFile.markdownDescription: A file to read the chat tiers' key's value from, in the same two forms as `jev.decide.apiKeyFile`.

jev.settings.markdownDescription: The server's own `jev` configuration section (PROTOCOL §10), passed through verbatim — `budget`, `triggers`, `rules`, `noise`, `languages`, `models`. The server reads it over `workspace/configuration`.

jev.artifacts.viewColumn.markdownDescription: Where a command's answer is shown. `active` opens it in the editor group you are already in, so the layout never changes. `beside` opens a new group to the right — with a single group open that is a split. `output` writes it to the **Jev** output channel and opens nothing. Commands whose answer is a value rather than prose (`jev.inspect`, `jev.status`, `jev.recompute`, `jev.revert`) always report to the channel, with a one-line message and a **Details** action.

jev.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the per-declaration lenses the server serves (`jev: explain`, `jev: N finding(s) · fix`).

jev.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Ask for the `jev: N finding(s)` badge. Off by default, as on every other jev client: the badge is only worth the space when it has something to say.
